units.source: props (muse.body.json absent: H = 2.30 from animals/muse.glsl M_H)
units.frame: H units; origin on the floor under the character's centre at rest; x screen-right, y up, z toward the camera

renderer.notes: engine/props.glsl: held = the grip anchor meets the palm (museGrasp pos - 0.07 palm normal), upright + camera-facing then the column turns; worn = museHeadFrame; furniture = free only

columns.x,y,z: H: free = offset from home (world axes); held/worn = small offset in the grasp/head frame
columns.rx,ry,rz: turns (periodic): free = about its own centre on top of the home rotation (world axes); held = ry turn it round (about up), rx tip toward/away from the camera, rz roll
columns.hl,hr: attach to the screen-left/right paw (both = two-paw hold / hand-over)

places.name: the floor
places.notes: the studio floor; the rug (x -2.70..2.20, z -1.60..1.90 scene) is 0.016 scene above it

places.name: the side table
places.notes: a low oak side table with a headphone stand (post + padded saddle) in the middle; the headphones hang there, their cups beside the table

places.name: the desk
places.seat_spots_notes: reachable from the chair pulled up at the desk (the sit point): the near strip (local z >= 0.34 scene of 0.42), left/right of the laptop at the work spot; small things only (mug, book, ball, plant) - the headphones are head-sized: seated, take them off round the neck (headphones worn.neck)
places.notes: moves with the desk: world = desk pos + Ry(desk ry)*local (+ the desk's prop offset). spots_local[3] = the front, closest to a sitter

articulation.meaning: band spread: 0 relaxed (cups pulled in, scene half-gap 0.42) .. 1 opened to the head (0.75); worn (hh) opens it by itself

handles.note: the top of the band: one paw lifts it
screen-left cup, relaxed band (two paws: put it on; opened to the head it is at -(0.75 + 0.17) scene)

pick_up_from.notes: a standing muse there (root_x/z, facing the table) clears the hanging cups; the band handle is then ~0.23 H in front at 0.51 H: in reach (reach map miss < 0.01 H)

worn.frame: museHeadFrame (head axes: x right, y up, z out of the face)

neck.notes: round the neck: hh = 1 with prop0_y = this y (H, head frame) and prop0_rx = this rx: the cups below the head, the band behind it (take them off while seated: there is no room for them on the desk)

worn.notes: hh = 1: the band over the crown (forward of the ears), cups on the head's sides at the ear line; put on = hold it by both cups (hl = hr = 1) at the head, then ease hh 0 -> 1 while hl/hr ease 1 -> 0

props.name: chair

handles.note: top rail of the backrest, its left end

seat.notes: sit: root at the sit point (root_y = (seat height scene - 0.37)/2.30, muse.body.json), facing the chair's front

props.notes: FREE furniture (never paw-attached): prop1_x/z move it on the floor, prop1_ry turns it about its vertical centre line; keep prop1_y/rx/rz 0

props.name: desk

handles.note: front edge of the top, left end
the left end of the top (pull it sideways)
the right end of the top

props.notes: FREE furniture; things on its top (place desk_top) move with it (the page keeps them consistent). sit_point_local = where a chair's sit point goes for working at the desk (front, centre)

props.name: silver laptop

articulation.meaning: lid: 0 shut .. 1 open (112 degrees about the back hinge)

handles.note: left side of the base (carry in two paws)
front edge of the shut lid (open: lift it here)

keyboard.notes: the key well on the base top, running to the front edge; typing = paws at keys_left/right (the near rows) with small up/down taps.  Reach: the muse's palm reaches <= 0.66 scene forward of its centre at desk height and its seated belly front is ~0.53, so the laptop's FRONT edge goes to the desk's near edge and the desk's near edge sits ~0.55 from the muse's centre (desk sit_point_local)

screen.notes: open (s = 1): the panel centre is ~0.62 scale above the hinge at the back edge, facing the sitter (+z, tipped back 22 deg)

props.notes: carry: hl = hr = 1 at side_l / side_r; slide on the desk: free x/z with the paws resting on it

articulation.meaning: 0 shut .. 1 open flat, pages to the front

floor_steps.note: the rug: a prop resting on the floor inside it sits this much higher

l.layout: flat, C order: index ((i*ny + j)*nz + k)*3 + c

r.layout: flat, C order: index ((i*ny + j)*nz + k)*3 + c

reach.notes: pos (flat, see layout) = the palm contact point (world H, rest body pose, root 0, hand_open/turn 0) for hand target (axes[0][i], axes[1][j], axes[2][k]); trilinear interpolation predicts it; invert by solving pos(h) = P (e.g. a few Gauss-Newton steps from the nearest grid node). palm_normal = out of the palm. A held object's grip anchor sits at pos + palm_normal * its extent toward the palm.
